Equip your business with seasoned experts on the ready. Gain pre-established terms and conditions, guaranteed response times, and access to all Sygnia breach preparedness services.
Prepare smart and act fast to recover rapidly and reduce business impact—at a lower cost.
Contact an Expert
Cyber attacks are a matter of “when” not “if”, making it paramount to prepare for the worst. Organizations can get in front of this challenge with experts by their side 24/7, to maintain breach readiness and prevent incidents from becoming a full-blown disaster.

HOW WE CAN HELP – PREPARE SMART. ACT FAST.
Sygnia’s Incident Response Retainer helps organizations prepare smart and act fast with world-renowned responders on speed dial, pre-established terms and conditions to hit the ground running, guaranteed response times at discounted rates, and access to all Sygnia incident preparedness services to minimize overall breach impact.
Since 2015, we’ve battled the most complex cyber events in both IT and OT environments by delivering holistic, end-to-end incident response assistance. Our deep military defender heritage enables us to think exactly like an attacker to guide you hands-on before, during, and after an incident—ultimately achieving cybersecurity resilience.

SERVICE TIERS
Sygnia’s Incident Response Retainer provides various service tiers for clients to select an option that best fits their specific business and budgetary needs. Sygnia works closely with your team in making the right choice to achieve your organization’s unique goals.
Each service tier includes onboarding and discovery to understand your environment for optimization of response efforts. Response guidelines are then defined and captured in a client-specific IRR activation playbook that enables an accelerated incident response.
